products.short_description: Know a VPN tunnel is broken before your users do — deploy scheduled, endpoint-side health checks through Intune that verify connectivity, surface telemetry, and alert when a tunnel goes unhealthy.
products.description:
Know a VPN tunnel is broken before your users do — deploy scheduled, endpoint-side health checks through Intune that verify connectivity, surface telemetry, and alert when a tunnel goes unhealthy.

Most teams find out a VPN tunnel is unhealthy from a wave of 'I can't connect' tickets — there is no proactive signal that the tunnel established, that routes and DNS work through it, that the auth certificate is still valid, or that the gateway is reachable. This solution builds that signal: a repeatable, endpoint-side health-check practice deployed through Intune. It defines what 'healthy' means for a VPN tunnel, deploys scheduled connectivity probes to managed devices (using the Proactive Remediations detection model), surfaces the results as telemetry you can report and dashboard, and alerts when a tunnel degrades — across Microsoft Tunnel, Windows Always On VPN, and third-party client VPNs. It is the MONITORING layer: it does not re-deploy any VPN (each VPN's setup lives in its own product) and defers Microsoft Tunnel gateway-SERVER health to the Tunnel Gateway product.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Define 'healthy' — the concrete health signals for a VPN tunnel (adapter/profile present, tunnel established, gateway reachable, routes + DNS resolve through the tunnel, auth certificate valid + not near expiry) and pass/fail thresholds
  • Deploy scheduled health checks — endpoint-side connectivity probes delivered via Intune (Proactive Remediations detection model) that run on a schedule and report tunnel health per device, across Microsoft Tunnel / Always On VPN / client VPNs
  • Telemetry & dashboards — roll health results up into reporting (Intune + Log Analytics/KQL where available) so you can see tunnel health across the fleet, by VPN type and by gateway; flagged verify-with-Microsoft for current data paths
  • Alerting — turn a degraded/expiring tunnel into an alert (cert nearing expiry, a cohort of devices failing to establish, a gateway unreachable) so you act before the ticket wave
  • Triage runbook — from a red health signal to the responsible layer (device, profile, cert, gateway, head-end), with pointers to the relevant VPN deployment/troubleshooting products for the fix

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A proactive VPN tunnel health-monitoring practice run through Intune — scheduled checks, fleet telemetry, and alerts that tell you a tunnel is failing before your users do, across whichever VPN technologies you run.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • VPNHEALTH-Deploy-HealthCheck.ps1 — create + assign the tunnel-health MONITORING package (Proactive Remediations detection). DEFAULTS TO -WhatIf
    • VPNHEALTH-Detect-TunnelHealth.ps1 — read-only DEVICE-SIDE VPN tunnel health check (Proactive Remediations detection)
    • VPNHEALTH-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of VPN profiles + the tunnel-health monitoring package
    • VPNHEALTH-Report.ps1 — fleet tunnel-health rollup export (per device: VPN type, verdict, cert days-to-expiry)
    • VPNHEALTH-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL that the tunnel-health monitor is deployed, assigned, running, and reporting

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
